integrity: Exact universal signed-orbit proof; exhaustive independent finite face/character tests for n=2..6 and reduced mod-two boundary tests for n=2..5, as detailed in the accompanying verification source.
scientific_limitations: Only rational homology of the natural C_2 x S_n subgroup is classified; the known underlying sphere-wedge homotopy theorem is used as a premise. Not an integral-lattice, full-automorphism or equivariant homotopy classification. Possible unindexed equivalent character calculations remain.
title: Rational automorphism characters of the Morse complex of \(K_{2,n}\)
